source: 698 Aftermath
target: 698 Postea

source: Considering Madam Magician’s conjecture, Lumian suddenly felt that the deceased Death, the ancestor of the Eggers family, was indeed legendary.
target: Ex coniectura Dominae Magicae considerata, Lumian subito sensit Mortem defunctum, progenitorem familiae Eggers, vere legendariam esse.

source: After becoming a true god, He seemed to have gone mad.
target: Postquam verus deus factus est, videbatur insanire.

source: He incited the Pale Disaster.
target: Instigavit pallidam cladem.

source: His demise created the Berserk Sea, isolating the Northern and Southern Continents for more than a millennium.
target: Eius exitus creavit Mare Furens, quod Continentes Septentrionales et Meridionales per plus quam mille annos segregavit.

source: He had a connection to the mysterious Underworld Daoist.
target: Habuit vinculum cum obscuro Daoista Submundi.

source: He buried the Abomination corpse of the Devil Monarch.
target: Sepulcravit cadaver abominationis Monarchae Diaboli.

source: He left behind the massive Balam Empire with numerous descendants.
target: Reliquit ingentem Imperium Balam cum plurimis successoribus.

source: The golden mask He created for His descendants to enter and exit the Underworld is still being fought over to this day…
target: Larva aurea quam creavit successoribus suis ad ingressum et exitum submundi, adhuc luctatur hodie…

source: Lumian retrieved the golden mask he had obtained from Hisoka from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian extraxit larvam auream, quam a Hisoka ex sacco Viatoris adeptus erat.

source: He caressed its cold surface and sighed silently.
target: Tangens superficiem eius frigidi, tacite suspiravit.

source: This is a true deity’s creation…
target: Haec est creatio verae deitatis…

source: With a sigh, Lumian read the last two pages of the lengthy letter.
target: Cum suspiri, Lumian duas ultimas paginas epistulae longae legit.

source: “Back to yourself.
target: “Redi ad teipsum.

source: The Underworld Daoist mark on you only seals the influence of the Blood Emperor’s remnant aura on the outside world.
target: “Signum Daoista Submundi in te tantum serat influentiam aurae reliquiarum Imperatoris Sanguinis in mundo extero.

source: It doesn’t eliminate its existence.
target: “Non tollit eius existentiam.

source: “In other words, you can no longer use Alista Tudor’s remnant aura to scare others.
target: “Id est, iam non potes uti aura reliqua Alistae Tudor ad alios intimidandos.

source: However, it can still be useful when you need to verify your corresponding ‘identity.’
target: “Tamen adhuc utilis esse potest, cum necesse sit identitatem tuam verificare.

source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: “There are pros and cons to this situation.
target: “Ad hanc rem sunt commoda et incommoda.

source: Although you’ve lost your potent means of intimidating others, you don’t have to worry about attracting the attention of certain high-ranking individuals by using the Blood Emperor’s remnant aura.
target: “Quamquam potentem modum aliorum intimidandi amisisti, non curandum est ne attentionem quorundam altiorum per usum aurae reliquiae Imperatoris Sanguinis allicias.

source: Furthermore, the Underworld Daoist mark might have a special effect in the future.
target: “Praeterea, signum Daoista Submundi in futurum effectum peculiare habere potest.

source: “Emperor Roselle once said that since you can’t resist, try to enjoy yourself.”
target: “Imperator Roselle olim dixit: cum resisti non possis, conare te frui.

source: Lumian turned his right hand over and looked at his palm.
target: Lumian dextram manum verteret et palmam intuebatur.

source: Compared to the decay in his dream, only a small pale-white mark remained.
target: Comparata corruptione in somnio suo, solum parva macula pallido-alba remansit.

source: Beneath the pale-whiteness, a faint red scarred mark could be seen.
target: Sub pallido albedo, apparuit tenuis rubra macula cicatricis.

source: What special use can it have?
target: Quid usus specialis esse possit?

source: To intimidate the undead?
target: Ad intimidandum mortuos?

source: Lumian muttered to himself in puzzlement, momentarily at a loss.
target: Lumian sibi murmurat perplexus, paulisper inopia captus.

source: At the end of the letter, Madam Magician wrote:
target: Ad finem epistulae, Domina Magica scripsit:

source: “This year’s Dream Festival may have ended, but the special dream and ancient tomb haven’t disappeared.
target: “Festival Somniorum huius anni finitum esse potest, sed somnium speciale et sepulcrum antiquum non evanuerunt.

source: The Dream Festival will still happen next year.
target: “Festival Somniorum adhuc fiet anno proximo.

source: “When the time comes, the Demon from the Nois family and His Rose School of Thought allies, who confirmed the ancient tomb’s situation this year, might continue their attempts.
target: “Quando tempus advenerit, Daemon ex familia Nois et socii eius Scholae Rosi, qui hanc annum condicionem sepulcri antiquae confirmaverunt, fortasse conatus suos continuabunt.

source: “They might even bring more targeted and powerful items, Beyonders, or projections.
target: “Fortasse etiam afferent instrumenta intendentiora et potentiora, Beyonders, aut projectiones.

source: “Not only do we have to stop them when the time comes, but we also have to make preparations in advance.
target: “Non solum eos prohibere debemus cum tempus advenerit, sed etiam praeparationes antea efficere.

source: “Furthermore, for the special dream to still have dream projections as guardians, we can’t relocate the entirety of Tizamo.
target: “Praeterea, ut somnium speciale adhuc proiectiones somniorum ut custodes habeat, totum Tizamo transferre non possumus.

source: “Therefore, we have to do something for the people here.
target: “Ergo aliquid pro hominibus hic agendum est.

source: “Of course, after completing the last task, the subsequent problems of the Dream Festival will have nothing to do with you unless you become an Angel by then.
target: “Scilicet, postquam ultimam munus perfeceris, quaestiones posteriores Festival Somniorum tibi nihil attinebunt, nisi tunc Angelus fias.

source: “But isn’t that too far-fetched?
target: “Sed nonne id nimis incredibile videtur?

source: “The last thing you need to do is enter that special dream with the half-finished brass charm I sent with the letter and perform the following ritual before the black ancient tomb.
target: “Ultimum quod tibi faciendum est est intrare in illum somnium speciale cum amuleto aeneo semi-perfecto quem epistula missa est et perficere sequentem ritum coram sepulcro antiquum nigro.

source: “The complete process of the ritual is:
target: “Processus ritus completus est:

source: After carefully reading the ritual’s description, Lumian assessed his spirituality and stowed away the half-finished brass charm.
target: Postquam descriptionem rituum diligenter perlegit, Lumian spiritualitatem suam aestimavit atque amuletum aeneum semi-perfectum reponit.

source: Then, he retrieved the golden box containing the peculiar soil, unfolded the letter, and penned a reply:
target: Deinde, extraxit cistam auream quae solum peculiare contineret, epistulam evolvit ac responsum scripsit:

source: “Honorable Madam Magician,
target: “Domina Magica Honorabilis,

source: “I will follow your instructions and complete the ritual.
target: “Mandata tua sequar et ritum perficiam.

source: “This is that strange soil…
target: “Hic est solum ille insólitum…

source: Lumian paused and added:
target: Lumian pausavit et addidit:

source: “Remember to send back the box containing it.
target: “Memento cistam, quae id continet, remittere.

source: It was made of gold!
target: Ex auro facta erat!

source: Recalling Lugano’s promise of compensation and Ludwig’s growing appetite, Lumian, who was quite wealthy, felt the need to be frugal.
target: Reminiscens Luganoeae promissionem compensationis et Ludovigi appetitum crescentem, Lumian, qui dives erat, sensit necessitatem parsimoniae.

source: He didn’t need to worry about the potion formula, Beyonder ingredients, or mystical items for the time being, but he needed to provide for two people now!
target: Non oportebat eum solliciti esse formulae potionis, ingredientium Beyonder, aut rerum mysticarum interim, sed nunc pro duabus personis curare debebat!

source: Furthermore, gold played an important role in mysticism.
target: Praeterea, aurum magni momenti partes in mystica habebat.

source: Franca had been accumulating gold in recent months, hoping to forge a golden body for “Armored Shadow” Chen Tu.
target: Franca proximis mensibus aurum congregabat, sperans corpus aureum conficere pro “Armored Shadow” Chen Tu.

source: After writing the reply, Lumian set up a ritual and summoned the “doll” messenger.
target: Postquam responsum scripsit, Lumian ritum instituit et nuntium “pupae” convocavit.

source: The messenger remained cautious and furtive, not uttering a word.
target: Nuntius cautus et furtivus mansit, neque verbum edidit.

source: What did it sense?
target: Quid sensit?

source: Lumian was about to inquire when he suddenly thought of a possibility.
target: Lumian quaerere vellebat, cum subito de aliqua possibilitate cogitavit.

source: Could it be because Miss Messenger, whom Madam Magician mentioned, had been here?
target: Num quia Miss Messenger, quam Domina Magica commemoravit, hic adfuit?

source: They are both messengers, so they might know each other and be related.
target: Illi ambo nuntii sunt, itaque fortasse se inter se noverunt atque connexus esse possunt.

source: And that person is an Angel…
target: Et ille Angelus est…

source: Lumian shut his mouth and watched as the “doll” messenger retreated into the candlelight with the golden box.
target: Lumian os clauserunt et observavit, dum nuntius “pupae” cum cista aurea in lucem candelarum recedebat.

source: He extinguished the candle, stowed away the ritual-related items, and returned to the living room.
target: Candellam exstinxit, res ritui pertinentes reponit, et in atrium rediit.

source: He sat across from Ludwig, who still had half his food left untouched.
target: Contra Ludovicum sedebat, qui adhuc dimidium cibi sui intactus retinebat.

source: Lumian looked at Ludwig, who wore a blue pajama hat with yellow stars, and smiled.
target: Lumian Ludovicum aspexit, qui pileum caeruleum cum stellis luteis gerebat, et subridit.

source: “Lend me something.
target: “Da mihi aliquid.

source: Ludwig raised his head, his mouth moving as he inquired with his eyes.
target: Ludwig caput levavit, et os movebat, dum per oculos quaerebat.

source: Lumian maintained a friendly smile.
target: Lumian amabilem subridionem retinuit.

source: “The gold coin from earlier.
target: “Moneta aurea ex priore.

source: Ludwig lowered his head and focused on eating a piece of beef jerky, as if he hadn’t heard Lumian.
target: Ludwig caput inclinavit et se intulit edendi partem carnei siccatae, quasi verba Lumiani non audiret.

source: “It’ll only take half an hour.
target: “Solum dimidiam horam requiriet.

source: “Yes, half an hour.
target: “Ita, dimidiam horam.

source: “I won’t cause any harm.
target: “Non faciam ullum damnum.

source: “I’ll definitely return it to you as it was,
target: “Certissime illud tibi reddam ut fuit,

source: Lumian said with a sigh.
target: Lumian suspirans inquit.

source: “I’ve been providing for you for a long time, giving you food and drink…
target: “Diu pro te curavi, cibum et potum tibi praebens…

source: At this point, Lumian suddenly stopped.
target: Ad hoc, Lumian subito sistit.

source: “Isn’t that worth lending me your lucky gold coin for half an hour?
target: “Nonne id dignum est ut mihi fortunatam monetam auream dimidiā horā mutuari?

source: “When have I ever lied to you?
target: “Quando tibi umquam mendacium feci?

source: “Often,” Ludwig mumbled.
target: “Saepe,” Ludwig murmurat.

source: He looked up at Lumian for a few seconds before retrieving the Loen gold coin from his pocket.
target: Aliquot secundis ad Lumian aspexit, antequam nummum aureum Loen ex sinu extraxit.

source: “Twenty minutes, tops.”
target: “Viginti minuta, non ultra.

source: “Deal!” Lumian swiftly accepted the lucky gold coin with a radiant smile.
target: “Pactum!” Lumian celeriter accepit fortunatam monetam auream, subridens radianti.

source: To conserve his spirituality, he refrained from teleporting.
target: Ut spiritualitatem suam conservaret, teleportandi consuetudinem abstinuit.

source: Instead, he moved swiftly through the shadows and arrived at “Hisoka” Twanaku’s house.
target: Pro eo, celeriter per umbras processit et ad domum “Hisoka” Twanaku pervenit.

source: Robert and Amandina had already left.
target: Robertus et Amandina iam discesserant.

source: Lumian found a spot and leaned against the wall.
target: Lumian locum invenit et ad murum se inclinavit.

source: Using Cogitation, he quickly drifted off to sleep.
target: Utendo Cogitatione, celeriter obdormivit.

source: In the special dream, in the primitive forest.
target: In somnio speciali, in silva primitiva.

source: Using the shadows in the darkness, Lumian reached the edge of the dream and found himself in the chaotic zone.
target: Utendo umbris in tenebris, Lumian finem somnii attigit et se invenit in regione tumultuosa.

source: After some thought, he left the shadow and donned the golden mask crafted by Death.
target: Post aliquantum cogitandi, umbram reliquit et larvam auream a Morte confectam induit.

source: Amidst the cold corrosion and heavy pressure, Lumian saw a dream fragment of a black ancient tomb and the path leading to it.
target: Inter corrosionem frigoremque et grave pressuram, Lumian particulam somnii sepulcri antiqui nigri et viam ad eum ducens vidit.

source: He quickly reached his destination.
target: Celeriter ad metam pervenit.

source: The corpses had vanished, leaving only the ancient tomb, resembling a black boulder, standing silently.
target: Cadavera evanuerant, relinquentes solum sepulcrum antiquum, quasi lapis niger, silentiter stantem.

source: Lumian removed the mask and observed for a moment.
target: Lumian larvam removit et per momentum observavit.

source: Using a raised tree root as an altar, he placed candles, essential oil, herbal powder, a cauldron, and the half-finished brass charm on it.
target: Utens radicem arboris sublata uti altare, candelas, oleum essentiale, pulverem herbarum, ollam, atque amuletum aeneum semi-perfectum super eam posuit.

source: He followed the instructions in Madam Magician’s letter and dealt with them one by one.
target: Mandata in epistula Dominae Magicae sequens, singula tractavit.

source: Finally, Lumian placed the lucky gold coin between the two candles corresponding to Mr. Fool.
target: Denique, Lumian fortunatam monetam auream inter duas candelas, quae Domino Stulto respondent, posuit.

source: Instead of creating a wall of spirituality, he lit the candles in the order from god to person, from left to right, and took two steps back.
target: Pro murum spiritualitatis creandi, candelas ordine a deo ad hominem, a sinistra ad dextram, accendit et duo gradus retrorsum fecit.

source: Lumian gazed at the burning candle flame and recited in ancient Hermes,
target: Lumian flammam candelae ardentem contemplatus est et in antiquo Hermes recitavit,

source: “The Fool that doesn’t belong to this era, the mysterious ruler above the gray fog; the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck…
target: “Stultus, qui hujus aetatis non competit, gubernator arcanus super nebulam cineream; Rex Flavus et Niger, qui fortunam bene regit…

source: Silently, a thin gray fog emanated from the void, enveloping the area around the black ancient tomb and the entire special dream.
target: Silentio, tenuis nebula cinerea ex vacuo emanavit, circumcludens aream circa sepulcrum antiquum nigrum et totum somnium speciale.

source: Lumian’s left chest heated up slightly, preventing his thoughts from slowing down, and his body showed no signs of disintegrating.
target: Pectus sinistrum Lumiani leviter calefactum est, impediens cogitationes eius retardari, et corpus eius nullos vestigia dissolutionis ostendit.

source: He quickly took two steps forward and ignited the corresponding essential oil extract and herbal powder.
target: Celeriter duo gradus incedit et accendit extractum olei essentialis et pulverem herbarum correspondentes.

source: He placed the half-finished brass charm in the center of the altar.
target: Amuletum aeneum semi-perfectum in medio altaris posuit.

source: Then, Lumian straightened up and said in Hermes, “I implore you,
target: Tum, Lumian se recte constituit et in lingua Hermes inquit: “Obsecro te,

source: “I implore you to grant this charm power.
target: “Obsecro te ut huic amuleto vim tribuas.

source: “I implore you to allow this power to control this dream…
target: “Obsecro te ut hanc vim sinas hunc somnium regere…

source: After reciting all the remaining incantations and completing the remaining steps of the ritual, Lumian saw the lucky gold coin emit a hazy glow.
target: Omnes reliquas incantationes recitatas et gradus rituum perfectos, Lumian vidit fortunatam monetam auream lucem nebulosam emittentem.

source: One of the candles representing Mr. Fool darkened, and the other took on a brass hue.
target: Una ex candelis, quae Domino Stulto repraesentabat, obscurata est, altera vero colorem aeneum assecuta est.

source: Immediately after, the darkness and brass candlelight entangled with the half-finished brass charm.
target: Statim postea, obscuritas et lumen aeneum candelarum cum amuleto aeneo semi-perfecto se implicaverunt.

source: The brass charm emitted a blinding light, and Lumian couldn’t help but close his eyes.
target: Amuletum aeneum lucem caecam emittens erat, et Lumian oculos claudere non potuit.

source: By the time he adjusted and opened his eyes, the brass charm had vanished.
target: Tempore quo se composuisset et oculos aperuisset, amuletum aeneum evanuerat.

source: The soil, rocks, and tree roots in front of the black ancient tomb surged, forming a tombstone-like object.
target: Solum, saxa, et radices arborum coram sepulcro antiquum nigrum effluxerunt, formantes rem similem lapide sepulcrali.

source: Ancient Feysac words appeared on the tombstone one after another:
target: Verba antiqua Feysac in lapide sepulcrali unum post alium apparuerunt:

source: “All living beings are equal before the law.
target: “Omnia entia viva ante legem aequalia sunt.

source: Even Angels can be killed by ordinary people.
target: “Etiam Angeli ab hominibus communibus necari possunt.

source: Lost items are regarded as abandonment.
target: “Res amissae ut relicta habentur.

source: Anything can be done during the Dream Festival, but not killing or rape.
target: “Quidquid fieri potest in Festival Somniorum, sed nec caedere nec violari.

source: Murderers shall die.
target: “Interfectores morientur.

source: Rapists shall die.
target: “Violatores morientur.

source: What… What pathway’s power is this?
target: Quae potentia viae hoc est?

source: It resembles the Arbiter pathway…
target: Similis est via Arbiter.

source: Killing isn’t allowed for the next Dream Festival?
target: Proximo Festival Somniorum interficere non licet?

source: Even an Angel can be harmed by me?
target: Etiam Angelus ab me laedi potest?

source: Lumian hadn’t expected Madam Magician’s preparations.
target: Lumian praeparationes Dominae Magicae non exspectaverat.

source: He swiftly packed his belongings and planned to leave the area.
target: Celeriter supellectilem condidit et decrevit locum relinquere.

source: Finally, Lumian had an idea when he saw the “tombstone.”
target: Denique, Lumian ideam cepit cum “lapidem sepulcrale” vidit.

source: With a smile, he retrieved a card from his Traveler’s Bag, bent down, and placed it on the ground beneath the tombstone.
target: Subridens, chartam ex sacco Viatoris extraxit, se inclinavit, et eam in terra sub lapide sepulcrali posuit.

source: It was a tarot card depicting a man in green holding a wand against attacking wands at the foot of a mountain.
target: Erat charta tarot repraesentans virum in veste viridi, qui baculum tenet contra baculos oppugnantes ad radicem montis.

source: Minor Arcana card, Seven of Wands!
target: Charta Minor Arcana, Septem Bacula!

source: Lumian didn’t know if the tarot cards representing him could remain in the dream or in front of the tombstone.
target: Lumian nesciebat num chartae tarot, quae eum repraesentabant, in somnio aut ante lapide sepulcrali manere possent.

source: He simply wanted to give it a try.
target: Simplicitate conari voluit.

source: After all, he hadn’t done so since becoming a member of the Tarot Club.
target: Postremo, id non fecerat ex quo membrum Tarot Club factus esset.

source: Upon returning to the real world, Lumian reached into his Traveler’s Bag and examined it.
target: Rediens ad mundum reale, Lumian in sacco Viatoris introit et examinavit.

source: As expected, the half-finished brass charm had vanished, as had the Minor Arcana card, the Seven of Wands.
target: Ut exspectabatur, amuletum aeneum semi-perfectum evanuerat, ac etiam charta Minor Arcana, Septem Bacula, evanuerat.

source: The rules of the special dream are indeed a little different… Lumian nodded thoughtfully and returned the lucky gold coin to Ludwig at the Brieu Motel.
target: Regulae somnii specialis re vera paulum differunt… Lumian cogitabunde annuit et fortunatam monetam auream Ludovico apud Brieu Motel reddidit.

source: Then, Lumian stepped onto the street.
target: Deinde, Lumian in viam processit.

source: In the darkness, he passed Camus, Rhea, Lugano, and the others, who were busy rescuing and treating people, and arrived at Saint-Sien Cathedral.
target: In tenebris, transiit Camus, Rhea, Lugano, et alios, qui homines servabant et curabant, et ad Cathedralem Sancti-Sien pervenit.

source: All the candles in the cathedral had been lit, but only Padre Cali was present.
target: Omnes candelas in cathedral accensae erant, sed solus Padre Cali aderat.

source: Dressed in a white robe adorned with golden threads, he knelt before the altar and the Sacred Emblem, his head bowed in anguish.
target: Indutus veste alba, filiis aureis ornata, ante altare et Emblema Sacrum genu flexit, caput in dolore inclinavit.

source: Lumian walked in step by step and took a seat in the front row.
target: Lumian gradatim processit et in prima ordinis sede consedit.

source: He watched Padre Cali quietly without disturbing him.
target: Padre Cali quiete observavit, neque eum perturbavit.
